title: The Táncház Movement: Urban Youth Discover Folk Roots
grammar: Ablaut twin-words and movement reduplications (*izeg-mozog, mendemonda, irul-pirul, tarka-barka*)
goal: I can say how the first táncház in 1972 brought village dance and music to young people in Budapest.
I can use twin-words such as *izeg-mozog*, *tarka-barka* and *mendemonda*, and put *izeg-mozog* into the past tense.
I can say what *népzenei gyűjtés* and *adatközlő* mean.
